current_status.stage: Phase 1 IND filed in Korea (April 2026); first-patient dosing targeted within 2026
current_status.data_point: Semaglutide loaded at ~20% density in microspheres; delivered in a 1 mL injection volume

finding_history.summary: Daewoong Pharmaceutical and TionLab Therapeutics announced a strategic partnership to jointly develop and commercialize a once-monthly long-acting semaglutide injectable, combining TionLab's Quject®Sphere platform (controls initial burst release via microparticle coating) with Daewoong's CURE® platform (produces uniformly sized microspheres for stable release). The formulation targets a 1 mL injection volume with ~20% drug loading, cutting annual injections from 52 (weekly) to 12 (monthly).

Corroborating coverage: the Daewoong-TionLab tie-up is framed as adding a long-acting injectable to Daewoong's existing oral and microneedle-patch obesity drug programs, giving the company a three-format anti-obesity portfolio.

Daewoong and TionLab filed a Phase 1 IND application with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety in April 2026 for the monthly semaglutide LAI candidate, with first-patient dosing planned within the year.
